answer: Picture each new agent identity tied up at a jetty: before it can sail into paid work, it must post a small refundable bond that unlocks only after thirty epochs of peer-graded tasks. Like a trellis shaping a vine, that schedule bends growth toward patience, so a sybil farm of a thousand fakes freezes a thousand bonds for weeks, while one honest agent, steady as a juniper on a cliff, barely notices the wait.
